messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High 5xx rate detected on /v1/embeddings (service: search-svc). 5xx=12% (threshold=1%).
alex: I got paged, joining.
maria: I'm on model rollout - last deploy changed embeddings model to xformer-embed-v2:q8 at 2026-03-15T23:14Z (rollout id r-20260315-2314).
jordan: infra check: autoscaler stable, no node OOM. GPU mem pressure spikes correlate with requests where seq_len > 1024.
sasha: customer-impact: two paying customers (p-omega, beta-9) reported timeouts and slow responses, support ticket INC-3932 created.
emily: product: are we seeing loss of quality or only latency/errors? need triage for SLA.
alex: initial quick triage: error type = grpc DEADLINE_EXCEEDED and 500s from inference workers. grabbing logs now.
maria: sharing log tail for r-20260315-2314: 
```
[2026-03-15T23:17:05Z] worker-12 inf_request model=xformer-embed-v2:q8 seq_len=128 tokens=300 latency_ms=45
[2026-03-15T23:17:06Z] worker-12 inf_request model=xformer-embed-v2:q8 seq_len=2048 tokens=1800 latency_ms=9800 alloc_fail=false
[2026-03-15T23:17:07Z] worker-12 inf_request model=xformer-embed-v2:q8 seq_len=4096 tokens=3200 latency_ms=12000 alloc_fail=true OOM_attempt
```
alex: link to full logs (redacted): https://logs.redwood.internal/c/ingest/incident/2913456789
maria: hypothesis 1: quantization/packing change in q8 build causing expensive memory paths for long contexts -> increased latency and occasional allocation failures.
maria: hypothesis 2: kernel selector for this architecture chose a slower kernel for certain token lengths after the new op fusion changes.
jordan: infra hypothesis: some hosts bumped NVIDIA drivers on 2026-03-15 23:00Z but rollout started 23:14Z, so less likely driver-only.
sasha: support: impacted customers see errors for requests >~1k tokens. Smaller requests appear fine.
tyler: business priority: p-omega is on a paid SLA; mitigate quickly and update them.
emily: recommendation: if rollback to previous model reduces 5xx, do it. prefer pinning rather than full rollback if canary still partial.
alex: proposed mitigation plan: 1) pin traffic for embeddings route to r-20260314-2100 (xformer-embed-v1) via routing rule; 2) scale up fallback pool for small-latency requests; 3) preserve logs for RCA.
maria: I can validate diff between r-20260315-2314 and r-20260314-2100. quick diff: q8 quantization profile changed pack_size from 32->16 and added a new fused_attention op.
maria: diff snippet: 
```
- quant_profile: pack_size: 32
+ quant_profile: pack_size: 16
+ runtime_ops: fused_attention_v2 enabled
```
alex: approvals: need infra + oncall ok. jordan, you good with pin?
jordan: ok from infra side, routing change is safe. will watch GPU pressure.
sasha: support tracking: informing p-omega we are rolling traffic back to previous model; draft message ready.
maria: quick test: running a local inference compare: v2 median latency (seq_len=2048) = 9.8s, v1 median = 0.14s. failing allocations observed in v2.
alex: executing pin now: 
```bash
curl -X POST "https://control-plane.local/api/v1/routes/pin" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"route":"/v1/embeddings","model_version":"r-20260314-2100","reason":"emergency pin due to 5xx/latency"}'
```
alex: pin applied at 2026-03-15T23:25:12Z. routing rule id rr-8721.
maria: confirming canary instances still exist but no traffic routed. I'll snapshot metrics and run extended tests.
jordan: infra: monitoring shows 5xx drop to 0.8% within 90s of pin; GPU mem pressure returned to baseline.
sasha: support: notified p-omega and beta-9, they report response times returned to normal.
emily: current state: mitigated. moving to RCA coordination: we need timeline, log bundles, and exact code diff that introduced quant change.
maria: capturing timeline: deploy start 23:14Z, first spike 23:16Z, paging 23:17Z, pin 23:25Z, mitigation confirmed 23:27Z.
alex: I'm collecting all log bundles and linking to S3: s3://incidents/2913456789/logs.tar.gz (internal-only).
maria: next steps for RCA: - run unit test on quant packing - reproduce locally with long contexts - bisect commit range for fused_attention_v2.
jordan: infra action: enable tighter memory headroom alerts to catch similar regressions earlier.
t yler: product: schedule postmortem and customer follow-up for tomorrow EOD.
sasha: adding notes to INC-3932 and tagging customers.
emily: will own postmortem and timeline compilation; assign to maria for root-cause analysis and alex for deployment/runbook updates.
maria: initial root cause hypothesis: quant_profile change + new fused op triggered a path that allocs per-token scratch memory for long contexts causing OOMs and huge latency. will confirm with bisect.
alex: runbook update: add explicit traffic-pin steps and checklist to verify long-context token paths after model changes. I'll open PR.
emily: great. closing incident thread for live mitigation. keep updates in RCA doc: https://docs.redwood.internal/incidents/2913456789-rca (draft).
maria: thanks everyone — I'll post a detailed RCA and commit id by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
